title: Platform Configuration
description: Schema for retrogaming platform BIOS configuration files

inherits.description: Parent platform config to inherit from (e.g., 'retroarch')

installable_cores.description: Buildbot libretro cores the platform's RetroArch core downloader installs on at least one board, from the RetroArch targets entry of that board's architecture.

dual_mode_cores.description: Emulators of standalone_cores the platform also launches as a libretro core: both layouts get their files

libretro_systems.description: libretro core name -> the systems the platform's system list offers it for, as the launcher names them. A launcher handing each core <save directory>/<system> (save_directory.by_system in the registry) places a file the core reads below its save directory once in each of these folders

core_system_dirs.description: The libretro system directory the platform hands each core, keyed by that directory relative to the pack root. A platform that declares it gives a core no other directory: the core's files are placed below each directory listed for it, and a core listed nowhere gets none (MinUI hands each launch tag its own Bios/<TAG>/)

cores.description: Libretro cores the platform starts with this directory, by the name of their .so

devices.description: Devices whose build ships a launcher for this directory

source_ref.description: file:line of the launcher that names the core, at the revision `source` pins

core_repositories.description: Repositories each core of core_system_dirs is built from, read from the platform's build recipes

system_directory_ref.description: file:line, at the revision `source` pins, of the code that sets the system directory core_system_dirs lists

source.description: URL to source BIOS requirements list

base_destination.description: Base directory for BIOS files on this platform

core_destination.description: With an empty base_destination, the directory core files go under (AmberELEC and EmuELEC declare bios/, neogeo/ and ports/ from /storage/roms, and their cores read bios/)

hash_type.description: Primary hash algorithm used by this platform

hash_rule.description: How a digest-mode frontend accepts a file when it is not one digest: size_and_any_hash requires the declared size, then any one of md5, sha1 and crc32 (RomM)

verification_mode.description: How the platform verifies BIOS at runtime: existence (file exists), md5 (checks MD5 hash), sha1 (checks SHA1 hash)

launchers.description: What the platform's own launch code looks for and hands to each emulator or core, read by its scraper at the revision `source` pins

configs_root.description: Where the frontend keeps its emulators' configs, as its own path code builds it (Batocera's batoceraPaths CONFIGS): path as the OS spells it, from_bios relative to the BIOS folder. A launcher that starts an emulator from a folder below it (shadPS4's configs/shadps4) places that emulator's user folder there, and the install manifest writes such a file as root: configs.

emulator.description: Emulator or core as the platform names it (comma-separated when one code path serves several)

kind.description: names_searched: tries the names in order, first found wins. fixed_name: writes or opens one path per name. core_option: sets a core option whose value names the file. passes_path: hands over a directory. links, copies: links or copies a file to where the emulator reads it (a copy names its files under search_dir, the folder it copies from, passes_to is the target, and the case that skips it is in depends_on_option). moves: moves a file the user left in one folder to the folder the launcher links from. scans_dir: the emulator picks from a directory. package: names no file, records what a package builds (`repo`) and the systems it registers (`systems`)

package.description: The platform package whose script this record comes from, when the platform installs emulators as packages

repo.description: What the package fetches and builds, as its script declares it: method, URL, then branch or commit

systems.description: Systems the package registers, under the platform's own names, in the order the script adds them. On a record handing a directory, the systems it is written for: the record applies to an emulator launched for one of them, and replaces there what the records naming no system hand

machines.description: On a record naming systems, the machines the platform offers the emulator under them, as the emulator names them: an entry of a profile system spelled like one of them is launched for those systems

slot.description: The key the launcher files this list under, such as a region or a machine

names.description: Names relative to search_dir, in the order the code tries or writes them. A {X} placeholder is expanded from `expands`

expands.description: Values a placeholder in `names` takes, in the order the code tries them for each name

case_insensitive.description: Whether the launcher matches names regardless of case

search_dir.description: Directory the launcher looks in, as the code resolves it. <system> stands for the platform system the emulator is launched for

passes_to.description: Where the found file is handed to the emulator: config key, command-line flag or core option

fails_when_missing.description: False when the launcher starts without the file, else the message it raises

fails_scope.description: emulator: the failure is raised only when every record of this emulator with the same source_ref found nothing

depends_on_option.description: Options or conditions in the launcher code that decide whether this record applies

device.description: Devices whose shipped config this record reads, comma-separated, set only where the configs of a package differ between devices

source_ref.description: path:lines in the platform's repository at the pinned revision

cores.description: The emulators and cores the platform's system list offers this system, as the platform writes them, in its order

dat_version.description: Version of the DAT file used as source for BIOS hashes

source.description: URL or reference to the source of BIOS requirements

required.description: false when the core runs without the tree; --required-only leaves it out

files.description: BIOS files required for this system

native_check.description: EmuDeck: the shape of the shell check written for this system

required.description: Whether this BIOS is required for the core to function

extract.description: Extract ZIP contents instead of copying the ZIP

storage.description: Storage tier: embedded (in repo), external (download at build), user_provided (manual)

source_url.description: Download URL for external storage tier

zipped_file.description: If set, the MD5 hash refers to this file inside the ZIP, not the ZIP itself

native_system.description: System id the platform itself uses for this file

mirror_of.description: Native system whose entry this one repeats. The platform's own file does not carry the copy

curated.description: Added by our scraper from the cores' source, not declared in the platform's own file

shared_group.description: Set on load, never written in a platform file: the entry joined the system from this group of _shared.yml, named by the system's includes. The platform's own file does not carry it

zip_digest.description: Set on load, never written in a platform file: the md5 of this ZIP is the md5 of its members concatenated in name order, as Recalbox computes it, never the md5 of the archive bytes

native_name.description: Display name the platform gives its own system

group.description: RetroBat: files sharing a group are alternatives. One held is enough and the others are reported OPTIONAL

md5_list.description: Batocera: the platform writes md5 as a list of strings, any of which matches. md5 holds the items comma-joined, in order

alt_md5.description: Second accepted MD5 (Batocera altmd5, ROCKNIX altmd5)

core.description: Cores the platform names for this file (comma-separated)

note.description: Free-text note the platform attaches to this file

description.description: Description the platform attaches to this file

hash_match_mandatory.description: Recalbox: a hash mismatch is an error, not a warning

mandatory_declared.description: Recalbox: mandatory was stated explicitly, not defaulted

required_label.description: RetroDECK: the requirement wording, which is free text

component.description: RetroDECK: the component whose manifest declares this file

alt_paths.description: Further paths the platform accepts for the same file

native_path.description: How the platform itself writes this file reference
